why_ai: Candles, brushes, pens and caskets are poured, set, assembled and finished on factory floors, and the formulation and finish judgements behind them stay with experienced hands, though imports and automation press on the commodity lines.
why_clarity: Specs, ASTM tests and retailer acceptance give checkable targets on recurring runs, but burn testing, blending and finishing are done by feel and field failures surface months later.
why_digital: Wax, filament, ink and wood become physical goods shipped to stores, sold through line reviews and reps, with EDI and portals digital only around the edges.

why_ai: Candles are physical combustion products tested on a bench by a chandler whose wick judgement carries recall exposure, and people keep buying them.
why_clarity: Burn tests have measurable criteria and recur every season, but the wick choice is tacit and real-world outcomes arrive months later.
why_digital: Wax, fragrance and glass in, physical candles out to stores, sold through retailer line reviews.

why_ai: Own-brand goods are still made physically to the retailer's spec, though the maker is interchangeable at re-bid.
why_clarity: The retailer's specification, audits and return rates define success exactly on repeat programmes, with returns lagging by weeks.
why_digital: Specs and artwork arrive through portals, but the product is physical and programmes are re-bid nationally and against importers.

why_ai: Caskets are welded, finished and delivered by hand to funeral homes on a deadline, through relationships with funeral directors.
why_clarity: Delivery before the service is a clear pass or fail, though models and finishes vary and stocking runs on regional feel.
why_digital: Steel and wood become physical caskets trucked from regional service centres to funeral homes ordered by phone.

why_ai: Brush making depends on setters' feel for blends and machines, and pros keep buying physical applicators.
why_clarity: Runs repeat and pull tests are objective, but 'feels right' to a painter is judged by experts who cannot write it down.
why_digital: Filament, ferrules and handles become physical brushes sold through paint stores and home centres.

why_ai: Guiding a new supplier through retailer onboarding is document and process work that software and agents absorb, with some hand-holding left.
why_clarity: Onboarding steps are written in each retailer's manual and the first season's net margin is measurable, but every maker's case differs.
why_digital: Manuals, EDI set-up and agreements are digital and the help can be bought remotely.

why_ai: Mapping SKUs to rules and drafting certificates from test reports is document work that language models do well, with a person signing.
why_clarity: Rules and required certificate fields are written down and SKUs recur, though errors surface only at a held shipment or a notice.
why_digital: Formulas, SDS and test reports in; certificates and eFiling data out, all on screen.

why_ai: Retrieving, matching and disputing retailer claims is rule-bound document work that agents already perform.
why_clarity: Each deduction or fine is valid or not under written terms, at high volume, with outcomes known within weeks.
why_digital: Portal records, remittances and shipping documents in; disputes and reports out online.

why_ai: Per-claim research and filing is exactly the portal and document work funded AI vendors now automate.
why_clarity: Claims are won or lost against written terms and evidence, thousands of times a year, with fast feedback.
why_digital: Entirely portal, EDI and document work, bought from vendors anywhere.

why_ai: Routing-guide checks and fine prediction are rule and data work, though the fix happens on a physical dock.
why_clarity: Each shipment meets the written guide or is fined, at high volume, with fines arriving within weeks.
why_digital: EDI documents, appointments and scans in; checks and alerts out, with the physical load behind them.

why_ai: Pulling POS and forecasting seasonal items is software work, with judgement left for new items and the re-order call.
why_clarity: Forecast error and unsold stock are exact, but each season gives one outcome per item.
why_digital: Retailer data in, plans out on screen, driving physical builds and shipments.

why_ai: The retailer's exclusive transaction data is a durable asset, while the analysis on top is increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Insight products recur on fixed definitions, though the value of a shopper finding shows up slowly.
why_digital: Transaction data in, dashboards and studies delivered online to suppliers.

why_ai: Perfumers and application chemists solve novel fragrance problems at the bench and in olfactive panels, inside long client relationships.
why_clarity: Burn and throw tests are measurable, but scent appeal is taste and the brief changes each time.
why_digital: Physical fragrance work in labs and panels, sold to makers through account teams worldwide.

why_ai: Connector maintenance and item mapping are data engineering that agents increasingly take over.
why_clarity: Mappings and refreshes are exact and checkable on recurring data loads.
why_digital: Entirely data in and dashboards out, sold as software.

why_ai: Elasticity and post-event analysis automate, but commercial advice to a CCO rests on trust and judgement about retailer negotiations.
why_clarity: Methods are known, but whether a promotion plan was right shows only after the season.
why_digital: Client data in, analysis and advice delivered remotely.

why_ai: Document translation and mapping against fixed standards is software work, protected mainly by network connections.
why_clarity: Each document conforms or fails, instantly, millions of times.
why_digital: Entirely electronic documents exchanged between systems.

why_ai: Statutory authority, recall negotiation and port inspection are accountable government acts, with analysis increasingly model-assisted.
why_clarity: Rules are written, but hazard findings rest on investigators' judgement and outcomes take months.
why_digital: Incident data and filings are digital, while inspections and sample testing are physical and the agency is a sole national authority.

why_ai: Underwriters carry accountable pricing decisions on rare losses, though routine classes automate.
why_clarity: Underwriting follows guidelines, but whether a price was right shows over years of claims.
why_digital: Submissions in, quotes and policies out on screen, sold through brokers.

why_ai: Listing chemicals and setting safe-harbour levels are statutory acts by accountable scientists.
why_clarity: Procedures are written, but the effects of a listing play out over years of notices.
why_digital: Scientific review and public records on screen, from a single state authority.

why_ai: Validating deductions against documents and filing disputes is the work these vendors are automating fastest.
why_clarity: Each claim is valid or not under written terms, at volume, with outcomes within weeks.
why_digital: Portal and document data in, disputes and recovered credits out online.

why_ai: Enforcement needs purchased products, lab tests and litigation through attorneys, though notice drafting automates.
why_clarity: Lab results against safe-harbour levels are checkable and notices recur, but settlements are negotiated.
why_digital: Physical products bought and tested, then notices and settlements handled on paper and screen in California.

why_ai: A board-certified toxicologist must stand behind each review, and the seal's standing is the product.
why_clarity: Reviews follow a written standard, but chronic-hazard judgements cannot be checked quickly.
why_digital: Formulations in, certification decisions and label statements out, mostly remote.

why_ai: Associations sell membership, standards work and meetings built on relationships, which AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Value to members is diffuse and judged by renewals.
why_digital: Some reports are digital, but the core product is meetings and committee work in person.

why_ai: Retrieval and destruction of product are physical, while notification and claims processing automate.
why_clarity: Recall completion and refund accuracy are measured against plans on recurring cases.
why_digital: Physical product returns plus call-centre and claims work, sold nationally.

why_ai: Deal selection and integration are relationship-heavy, high-stakes judgements with slow feedback.
why_clarity: Each deal is different and its outcome is known years later.
why_digital: Financial data and memos are digital, but deals are sourced and closed in person.
